name: Acid/base activity-window design
description: Find two logarithmic acid/base activities consistent with a declared pH target window and authored activity bounds; the two unused native coordinates remain zero.
unit: dimensionless log10 activity; auxiliary coordinates dimensionless
assumptions: Single acid/conjugate-base equilibrium with thermodynamic activities and compatible standard states; pH=pKa+log10(a_base)-log10(a_acid).
pKa=7.2 and target pH 7.0..7.4 are illustrative. No named acid, buffer, temperature, ionic strength or measured constant is asserted.
The declared pH interval becomes -0.2<=q_base-q_acid<=0.2. Its Euclidean signed distance divides the affine margin by sqrt(2).
Both log10 activities are restricted to [-8,0] as an authored design domain; this range is not a general thermodynamic bound.
Activities are dimensionless. Treating them as concentrations requires additional activity-coefficient assumptions absent from this problem.
The third and fourth coordinates are mathematical padding constrained to zero, not extra chemical species.
The problem does not solve electroneutrality, buffer capacity, temperature dependence or a multi-acid mixture; a feasible result is conditional on the supplied pKa.
One explicit feasible witness is [-3,-3,0,0], giving pH 7.2.
